cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: How will Catherine react to being completely abandoned and humiliated?

cliffhanger_anchors.why: Freezes the dramatic confrontation at the peak of her emotional paralysis.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Why has Alexander chosen the chained bride over Catherine?

cliffhanger_anchors.why: Ends the episode on a devastating twist and a lingering question about his true intentions.
